hardware_resource_class: single-host CPU only; no GPU requirement; ordinary local execution environment
restart_policy: one deterministic run under this budget; crashes or infrastructure failures are preserved and do not silently reset the 300-second budget; any fresh full-budget restart is a successor search pass
checkpoint_policy: preserve best-so-far candidate on every strict score improvement and emit a final checkpoint; optional periodic progress records may be written but do not extend the wall-clock budget
forbidden_inferences: search exhaustion establishes a lower bound
no witness means 45 comparators are necessary
immutability: Any increase in wall time, worker count, paid resources, or seed set creates a successor search-budget artifact and search pass.
